verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm Render serves a live llms.txt at render.com/llms.txt and a markdown docs index at render.com/docs.md. The cited docs pages are themselves served as .md (e.g. docs/cli.md, docs/mcp-server.md), and Render offers a 'Coding agents' docs section plus 20+ official agent skills with Render-specific guidance. Missing for 10: detail on the llms.txt content beyond its header, and independent user reports of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://render.com/llms.txt # Render
PROBE docs-md: HTTP 200 at https://render.com/docs.md # Render
They give coding agents Render-specific guidance for deploying, configuring, debugging, monitoring, and scaling your applications.
